_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil regime with 3% base rate of ±2pt 12h moves and no proven macro/calendar trigger; HOLD is the graded call until range break plus flow shock.
next_move.brains_agree: partial split — analyst explicit HOLD/Anxiety; narrative implies constructive accumulation without a directional phase call
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC remains rangebound and phase score holds inside Anxiety (39-46) with no ETF-flow or funding impulse
next_move.invalidated_if: Range break plus ETF-flow or funding shock that moves score ±2 out of Anxiety
